svg.title: 2 × 2 systolic GEMM architecture
svg.desc: Signed INT8 matrix operands and INT32 accumulators, with MatrixDim N = 8, 16 or 32. Shared top-level and tile control, three single-port SRAMs, four N-word FIFOs, four MACs, and serialized C writeback. A moves right and B moves down through a 2 by 2 PE array. A1 and B1 begin one clock later; invalid FIFO values are zeroed. Each PE retains one C result. Solid arrows show data, dashed arrows show control. Each tile loads for 2N+1 clocks, primes for one clock, computes for N+2 clocks, then stores four results in four clocks; tile handshakes are excluded.
